description: Use this when the user needs the outgoing mail (SMTP) server settings for an email provider or sending service, such as Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Zoho, Amazon SES or SendGrid. Returns the host, ports with encryption, what to use to log in, and the provider's setup guide. Never asks for the user's credentials.

provider_name.description: The email provider name to look up, e.g. gmail, sendgrid, mailgun, outlook

name: smtp_finder
title: SMTP Finder
